item.title: Meta: Meta Update
item.description:
The first class ofAmerica’s Workforce Academy(AWA) has graduated, and they’re headed to Meta construction sites to help build America’s future.
Nearly every major industry in the US is desperate to hire more skilled workers. But what’s been missing is a pathway linking America’s workers to America’s needs. We designed AWA, Meta’s free training program, to bridge that gap.
AWA provides four weeks of hands-on training and Meta covers travel and lodging expenses for participants. After graduation, a job with a Meta partner is already waiting for them.
“You can come into the program with no prior data center experience and be able to, after you finish, go into the workforce. [These students] will get promotions and become leaders — they’ll become foremen, superintendents, safety project managers. They can become engineers, coders, estimators. There’s so many different paths that they can take from what they’re learning here, and literally change their future.”
